discovery_note: Ternary ⟨2,2,2⟩=7 base realising a recombination multiset not otherwise in the catalog. At a 2-part split (n₁≥n₂ per axis) the sub-shape multiset is 2·⟨n₁,m₁,p₁⟩ + 1·⟨n₁,m₁,p₂⟩ + 1·⟨n₁,m₂,p₁⟩ + 1·⟨n₂,m₁,p₁⟩ + 2·⟨n₂,m₂,p₂⟩. Concretely at (9,8)³ → ⟨17,17,17⟩: 2·⟨8,8,8⟩ + 1·⟨8,9,9⟩ + 1·⟨9,8,9⟩ + 1·⟨9,9,8⟩ + 2·⟨9,9,9⟩. Found by exact GL₂(ℚ)³-orbit enumeration (Ternary2x2x2Orbit / RecombinationMultisetOrbit); de Groote-equivalent to Strassen.
